relationships.subject: ZR8 mAb
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with a monoclonal antibody targeting CGRP (ZR8 mAb) effectively reduced cisplatin-induced mechanical hypersensitivity and thermal nociceptive sensitization

relationships.subject: ZR8 mAb
relationships.evidence_quote: attenuated neuroinflammation as marked by downregulated expression of IL-6, IL-1β, and NLRP3 in the mice spinal cord and spleen

key_findings: CGRP and astrocyte activation increase in spinal cord after cisplatin; anti-CGRP mAb relieves CIPN and reduces IL-6, IL-1β, NLRP3.
